messages.en:
{ff 00 00 06}Sable {ff 00 00 00}and {ff 00 00 06}Mabel{ff 00 00 00} carry some
nice clothes, I'll give them
that much.
But nothing beats wearing
your own, specially designed
and handmade clothes!
messages.et:
{ff 00 00 06}Sable {ff 00 00 00}ja {ff 00 00 06}Mabel{ff 00 00 00} müüvad
kenasid riideid, seda ma
neile annan.
Aga miski ei löö oma
spetsiaalselt kujundatud ja
käsitsi tehtud riideid!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I've been studying fashion
very seriously. Someday,
I'll earn {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00}'s respect.
{07 0a 00}It's my own ambition to
become one of the elite:
A {ff 00 00 02}fashionista{ff 00 00 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ma olen moodi väga tõsiselt
õppinud. Kunagi teenin ma
{ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} austuse.
{07 0a 00}Minu enda auahnus on
saada üheks eliidist:
{ff 00 00 02}moeguruks{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
If you want to look smart,
you need to pick good
glasses as well as clothes.
So tell me, {04 1f 00},
what do you think of {07 0b 00}girls
who wear glasses?{02 01 00 03 04 05}
They're cute!
Blech!
They're chic!
messages.et:
Kui sa tahad tark välja
näha, pead sa valima head
prillid ja riided.
Nii et ütle, {04 1f 00},
mida sa arvad {07 0b 00}tüdrukutest,
kes kannavad prille?{02 01 00 03 04 05}
Nad on nunnud!
Äh!
Nad on šikid!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm impressed, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Most people think glasses
make you look like a nerd.
But the right glasses can
be the perfect fashion
accessory, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Muljetavaldav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0f 00}
Enamik arvab, et prillid
teevad sinust nohiku.
Aga õiged prillid võivad
olla täiuslik moeaksessuaar,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, are you saying
I should get contact lenses
instead, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Ew! Ew ew ew! I don't like
the idea of sticking things
in my eyes, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, kas sa ütled, et
ma peaksin hoopis
läätsed võtma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}Äh! Äh äh äh! Mulle ei
meeldi mõte torgata asju
oma silma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Here's a little tip just in
case {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} decides to test
your fashion know-how.
She rates glasses very high
in the fashion world.{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 16 00}The problem is they get
foggy in the shower!{01 00 00 05 00} Ah,
how we suffer for fashion!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Siin on väike vihje juhuks,
kui {ff 00 00 06}Gracie{ff 00 00 00} otsustab sinu
moetarkust testida.
Ta hindab prille moes väga
kõrgelt.{01 00 00 0f 00}

{07 16 00}Probleem on see, et need
udutavad duši all!{01 00 00 05 00} Ah,
mida kõike moe nimel!
